summary: In the conceptual design session, the team finalized the core product architecture, combining wooden and rubber tactile materials, dual solar and battery power, and basic vocal command shortcuts. An initial action item assigning physical clay prototype modeling to the User Interface Designer was reassigned mid-meeting to the Industrial Designer due to tooling and modeling expertise requirements. The User Interface Designer was subsequently reassigned to produce the 2D button symbol layout specification.
decisions: Approved hybrid casing materials incorporating natural wood and tactile spongy rubber
Adopted dual power supply utilizing both traditional batteries and solar energy cells
Selected a low-level integrated chip to keep manufacturing costs within the 12 Euro budget
Integrated basic voice command shortcuts for power and channel switching alongside standard buttons

action_items.task: Build the 3D physical clay prototype mockup of the remote control (reassigned from User Interface Designer)
Produce the 2D button symbol layout and graphical specification
